name: usage-pacing
description: Soft alerts on weekly Claude quota usage vs a linear pace (statusline + hook + skill).

display.title: Statusline display
display.description: statusline: show 'wk N% / pace M%' in the status bar. silent: still track usage but draw nothing.

alert_channel.title: Alert channel
alert_channel.description: context: Claude relays a one-line alert in chat (works in remote sessions too). push: also asks Claude to send a mobile push (needs Remote Control + push enabled in /config). none: no alerts.

over_pts.title: Over-pace threshold (points)
over_pts.description: Alert when usage is at least this many percentage points above the linear pace.

under_pts.title: Under-pace threshold (points)
under_pts.description: At session start, hint when usage is at least this many points below pace.

throttle_hours.title: Min hours between alerts
throttle_hours.description: Minimum gap between injected alerts of the same kind.
